items.why: Citi raised its price target to $800 from $575 and Mizuho to $705, citing AI chip demand from Meta's Muse boom. CEO Lisa Su said AMD will significantly increase 2027 chip shipments.
Melius Research upgraded Microsoft to Buy with a $665 target, calling the company the trusted 'adults in charge' of AI. Scotiabank and Piper Sandler also raised targets as Azure momentum continues.

Oil fell for a third session as recovering Middle East crude exports eased supply fears. Saudi Arabia restored its East-West Pipeline to 5.8M barrels a day and the G7 agreed to an emergency reserve release.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape. Big Tech names, including Amazon, edged higher as easing yields and oil lifted sentiment ahead of earnings season.

market_note: Index futures pointed higher Tuesday after the Nasdaq's record close, with oil sliding for a third straight day as Middle East crude flows recovered.
summary: Stocks are pushing higher with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq touching all-time highs, led by AI chip names as Treasury yields dipped and oil prices fell.
